description: This file contains the implementation of GST Settings management, including data loading, validation, and email reminder functionalities related to GSTIN updates within the ERPNext system.

classes.name: EmailMissing
classes.description: Custom exception class for missing email scenarios.

classes.name: GSTSettings
classes.description: Main class managing GST settings, including data loading, validation, and related operations.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Loads address data related to India and GSTIN presence into the object.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the GST account entries for duplicates.

methods.name: validate_duplicate_accounts
methods.description: Checks for duplicate GST accounts within the settings.

methods.name: send_reminder
methods.description: Sends a reminder email to parties to update their GSTIN, respecting a 3-day interval.

methods.name: send_gstin_reminder_to_all_parties
methods.description: Sends GSTIN update reminders to all relevant parties in India with addresses lacking GSTIN.

methods.name: send_gstin_reminder
methods.description: Sends a GSTIN reminder to a specific party (Customer or Supplier).

methods.name: _send_gstin_reminder
methods.description: Internal function to compose and send the actual email reminder for GSTIN update.
